{{Quote|I don't get many visitors out this way. A delivery droid, a roosting thranta, the odd sail-speeder.|Eckard Lokin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
A '''sail-speeder''' was a type of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].
